title: Use the centre to gain time
summary: Use central pawn threats, then develop; answer queen pressure before pushing blindly.

fromNode.nodeId: e4 e5 Nc3 Nf6 f4 Nc6 fxe5 Nxe5 d4 Ng6

goal: Use central pawn threats, then develop; answer queen pressure before pushing blindly.

steps.text: Look for a central pawn advance that attacks a knight, but check whether your king is in check first.
Develop the king-side knight when it does not ignore a direct threat.
If the opposing queen adds pressure to the centre, defend that pressure before pushing again.

jobs.text: The knight controls e4 and d5 from here.
The pawn controls e5 from here.
The pawn controls d5 from here.

opponent.text: Black can use the queen to add pressure to your central pawns. Your space advantage does not remove the need to defend.

notNow: Do not push another pawn automatically when the opposing queen creates a direct threat.

mistakes.text: Moving the bishop to a6 leaves it capturable by the b7 pawn. Do not sacrifice it without a concrete follow-up.

models.title: Use the centre to gain time

comments.text: Bring your pawn to e5. From e5 it attacks the knight on f6; an attack is not a guarantee of winning it.
Bring your queen to e2. From e2 it controls e4 and e5. Keep watching Black's replies before advancing more pawns.
